name: Tooth Grinder
body:
School transmutation [pain]; Level adept 2, druid 2, lathspell 2, shaman 2, witch 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a cracked tooth)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause immense pain in a target and cause their teeth to turn to dust. The target must make a Fortitude save. On a failure, the target takes 3d6 damage and is unable to use any natural attacks using their mouth or mouths. If the target succeeds on their saving throw, they only take 2d6 damage. If the target has no teeth, they are immune to this spell. At the end of the duration the target’s teeth return to normal.

Tooth Grinder, Mass

School transmutation [pain]; Level adept 4, druid 4, lathspell 4, shaman 4, witch .

Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as tooth grinder, except it affects multiple creatures as noted above and the damage on a failure increases to 5d6 and on a success 3d6.
